finalText:
Green. 625/625.

Only 3 real failures, all `orderTotal` — rows with both discount and tax non-zero. Rest of wall was noise.

Bug: tax computed on pre-discount base, then added.

```js
const tax = roundCents(cents * taxRate);   // cents, not discounted
return discounted + tax;
```

Contradicted own doc comment ("tax what's actually owed"). Fix in `src/pricing.js:39`:

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```

Hidden because 66 of 69 order rows had zero discount or zero tax — both paths agree there.
